verdicts.reason: A shrinks everything into the leaderboard. The logo, 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS', the headline, the subcopy, the date, the pills, the RSVP button and the URL line all become microscopic. 'Sunset Sessions' is barely bigger than the body text, so there is no hierarchy. It does keep the CTA and the left-to-right order. B makes 'Sunset Sessions' and 'Saturday 21 June' readable and clearly dominant, but it drops the RSVP button and the logo. Its description paragraph is unreadably small, and 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' sits below the headline instead of above it. The pills are jammed against the top edge.
